WITH r AS (SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit) AS book, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) AS status, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error) AS error, SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.event_at) AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_at, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.updated_at) AS TIMESTAMP), timestamp) AS updated_at FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source)), picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM r), latest AS (SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MAX(updated_at) AS ts, MIN(COALESCE(event_at, updated_at)) AS started, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(IF(error = '', NULL, error) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book), timed AS (SELECT *, IF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'), TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ts, started, MINUTE), NULL) AS took_min FROM latest), previous AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM r WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))), not_started AS (SELECT book FROM previous WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM latest)) SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(ts), MINUTE) AS ts, COUNTIF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED')) AS processed FROM timed

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit) AS book, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) AS status, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error) AS error, SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.event_at) AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_at, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.updated_at) AS TIMESTAMP), timestamp) AS updated_at FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source)), picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM r), latest AS (SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MAX(updated_at) AS ts, MIN(COALESCE(event_at, updated_at)) AS started, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(IF(error = '', NULL, error) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book), timed AS (SELECT *, IF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'), TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ts, started, MINUTE), NULL) AS took_min FROM latest), previous AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM r WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))), not_started AS (SELECT book FROM previous WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM latest)) SELECT book, status, took_min, runs, started AS first_event, ts AS last_update, last_error FROM timed UNION ALL SELECT book, 'NOT STARTED', NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM not_started ORDER BY IF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'), 1, 0), took_min DESC, book LIMIT 500
